title: Weekend Charge Calculation for Mobile In-Home Collection Visits
content:
**Calculation note, Specimen Collection Appointments.** A collected Mobile In-Home Collection Visit whose appointment date is a Saturday or Sunday carries one weekend charge equal to the published weekend surcharge of 35.00, posted as one assessed weekend surcharge rounded to the cent; a weekday visit carries none.

## Formation of the charge

The weekend charge is formed in one fixed order. The amounts that make up the weekend amount — the weekend day rate, which is the published weekend surcharge of 35.00, together with any amount added to it — are added together first. The weekend amount is then multiplied in turn by each multiplier the weekend charge carries, each multiplication acting on the result of the one before. The weekend charge is rounded to the cent only once, at the end.

The day is the day of the week of the visit's appointment date on the visit record — not the booking date and not the date the charge is posted.

## Worked figures (hypothetical visits)

| Appointment date falls on | Weekend amount | Weekend charge posted |
|---|---|---|
| Saturday | 35.00 | 35.00 |
| Sunday | 35.00 | 35.00 |
| Wednesday | — | None |

**Points of judgement.** The published weekend surcharge of the Mobile In-Home Collection Visit is 35.00; every other visit type publishes 0.00. A weekday home visit carries no weekend charge at all, whatever its start time.
